reasoning: This suite covers every rule in the x-rules register with emphasis on the named boundaries, permission consequences, closed-state behavior, required role header, unknown-case handling, and the 429 header requirement. It deliberately leaves out duplicate happy paths and schema-deep assertions not tied to a rule, to keep the suite small and sharp.
